title: Runtime/Critical-E2E verification gate
goal: Verification-only gate: start isolated canonical runtime, probe health/core APIs, then run critical E2E. Route any defect to its scoped ticket; do not fix source inside this gate ticket.
implementation_steps: Resolve the critical-E2E toolchain only if still missing
Set isolated ZBC_DB_PATH and start with powershell scripts/start_production.ps1
Run /healthz and runtime-surface/core-API probes including identity and BMP
Run critical non-mock E2E and record evidence
If a defect occurs, return to its scoped ticket instead of editing under RUNTIME-GATE-1

minimal_test_commands.Level_E_full_suite_GATE_ONLY: python -m pytest tests -m "not online" -q only at gate

runtime_probe: $env:ZBC_DB_PATH='<tmp>/monitor.db'; powershell scripts/start_production.ps1; GET http://127.0.0.1:8201/healthz; python scripts/verify_p0d_runtime_surface.py
e2e_probe: Critical user chains, non-mock, evidence retained
expected_after: Runtime gate passes with no core 404/fake200 and isolated DB; critical E2E evidence exists.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime + critical E2E all pass with evidence; protected DB unchanged.
